roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — learn Leonida, do the one missable thing
roadmap.text: Play the story. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation — the only possibly missable trophy in the game. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, so save at the start and end of every chapter (15 manual slots, 1 autosave). Cheats switch trophies and saving off, so leave them alone.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2 — both leads playable, open the map
roadmap.text: After Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call your partner into free-roam — that unlocks the partner trophies and the both-leads training. Buy garages through the Vice City Real Estate app, register vehicles with Moses, and start Billy's line at Thrillbilly Mudclub.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3 — Vice City, heists and side lines
roadmap.text: Vice City opens up: the Cartel Heist, the Key Cloner (Randy's cars, the blue Banshee showroom), Yasmani's jewelry jobs (Snap Gun, fences), and the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Lucia-only Andy and Jason-only Tyrone lines start here.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 — the big jobs
roadmap.text: Child's Play, Headliners and the VCIA Takedown, plus the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it unlocks bank vault robberies, which also hand you the armored-truck trophy and the 4-star escape. Finish Kenton's treasure dives and Bret's hunts while you are here.

roadmap.title: Chapter 5 & finale — finish the story
roadmap.text: Operation Savage Glory, then the final mission and the gold. After the credits you stay in free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Nothing on it is missable.

roadmap.title: Cleanup — activities, collectibles, strangers
roadmap.text: Stunts (250 of 397), shooting ranges (42 gold medals), drone races (14 locations), 20 race wins, card sets, WAiNK scans, challenges (50 of 80), vehicle discovery, full map unfog, one gang operation per gang, and the 8 stranger strands.

roadmap.title: Cleanup — money, profile & 100%
roadmap.text: Finish the 100% checklist (gold), the money trophies, the plane and the tank, the cocktail and the bike kicks, and the 500 criminal-profile actions. Bad Luck, I Guess is still unconfirmed — check the trophy's note before chasing it. The platinum pops when the other 54 are done.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.summary: The hardest trophy: reach 100% on the in-game checklist. It is far more forgiving than true 100% — closer to 60% of the game.

steps.text: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable.
Complete any 100 optional missions. There are far more than 100 in the game (easily 200–300), and each Moses or Randy vehicle delivery counts too.
Scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app, and study any 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars.
Do every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and all of Bret's 15 target decks — those are the only tasks that need everything.
Complete any 70 of the 80 challenges, so you can skip the hardest 10. Most collectible types are only partly required.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.summary: With your partner beside you, reach 4 stars and escape the red heat zone.

steps.text: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — that is when you can free-roam with both leads together. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. A fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works well; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down.

Easiest escape: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area.
It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars and an escape.

trophies.summary: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while the wanted level stays on.

steps.text: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch leads and call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while the police chase you the whole time. Keep the flashing wanted level — do not let it drop to the red heat level or clear entirely.

Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline from Ammu-Nation). A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop. If it does not pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going. Rob a couple of items per store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.summary: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK. No need to drive them.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning alone is enough — you do not need to drive it.
Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes).
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 scanned base-model vehicles, so this pops early on that road.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.summary: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Buff your focus first and pick gang criminals, not cops.

steps.text: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm. It slows time, highlights weak spots and drains the purple focus bar — it only lasts a few seconds.

Buff focus first: eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the focus time. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover.
Line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon such as the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians.

It gets easier as your Focus level rises (4 levels, under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus). Shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots all raise it — by the endgame you will likely be at level 4.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.summary: Steal a big passenger plane docked at a VCIA departure terminal and fly it 1 km away.

steps.text: Go to Vice City International Airport. Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield.
Easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge — a door leads straight into the plane.
Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.summary: Use the Snap Gun to slip in the back door of a jewelry store, loot the safe, kill the footage and the alarm.

steps.text: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. It unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons) in unfogged areas.
Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory, no need to equip it. Kicking the door trips the alarm, so do not kick it.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, then destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.
A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

steps.text: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe). It is marked automatically from story progress and teaches bank vault robbery: tail a security van to a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash in, the vault opens — slip in fast and rob it. After that mission, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 (finish his Payday Loan jobs first). The tips mark vans with a purple icon — follow them to the bank.

Every vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level. Escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way — up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.summary: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. It mostly happens on its own.

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.

Turn on notifications first: Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On. Every time you do something that affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen.

Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing many cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — which is permanent, so avoid excessive violence.

It will very likely happen passively while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist. If it is your last trophy, farming it by running over civilians and cops works — but cops will shoot on sight at Psycho or Irredeemable.
